# Video Quiz

> Video Quiz turns YouTube videos and uploaded study materials into interactive AI-generated multiple-choice quizzes.

## Website
- Homepage: https://video-quiz-rose.vercel.app/
- YouTube video to quiz: https://video-quiz-rose.vercel.app/youtube-video-to-quiz/
- AI quiz generator for teachers: https://video-quiz-rose.vercel.app/ai-quiz-generator-for-teachers/
- Long video quiz generator: https://video-quiz-rose.vercel.app/long-video-quiz-generator/
- How to make a quiz from a video: https://video-quiz-rose.vercel.app/how-to-make-a-quiz-from-a-video/

## What it does
- Generates multiple-choice quizzes from YouTube videos.
- Accepts supported PDF, TXT, and image study materials.
- Provides explanations for answer choices.
- Returns missed questions in a review round.
- Links video questions to approximate timestamps when available.

## How to use
1. Open the homepage.
2. Paste a YouTube video URL or choose supported study files/photos.
3. Select 5, 8, or 12 questions.
4. Select Make quiz and answer the questions.

## Notes
- Video analysis time and availability depend on the source video and AI service.
- Upload size and file-count limits are shown in the app.
- Do not describe the service as guaranteeing perfect accuracy or unlimited video length.
